Tâches de recherche en file

  • JO-DIGITAL-ACCESSIBILITY-DISCOVERY-001 — Découverte de sources — Non commencée

    Identify authoritative instruments and exact provisions for government policy; do not infer absence or legal effect.

  • JO-AI_GOVERNANCE-DISCOVERY-001 — Découverte de sources — Non commencée

    Identify official legislative sources governing AI and public automated decisions and related legal concepts; do not make legal-effect claims.

  • JO-DATA_CENTRES-DISCOVERY-001 — Découverte de sources — Non commencée

    Identify official legislative sources governing environmental and infrastructure obligations and related legal concepts; do not make legal-effect claims.

  • JO-DIGITAL_RIGHTS-DISCOVERY-001 — Découverte de sources — Non commencée

    Identify official legislative sources governing expression/privacy safeguards and related legal concepts; do not make legal-effect claims.

Questions de recherche ouvertes

Ces questions sont des lacunes de recherche consignées, pas des conclusions juridiques.

  • The publication date and resulting six-month commencement date are not established from the captured English translation. (JO-24-01)
  • The retroactive application to data processed before commencement needs a clause-level scope analysis. (JO-24-02)
  • The official English translation and the Arabic text may differ; the authoritative-language status is unresolved. (JO-24-03)
  • Capture policy and determine accessibility-specific provisions and scope. (jo-digital-inclusion-2025)
  • Capture Arabic authoritative legislation and distinguish effective date, transition period and exceptions. (jo-personal-data-2023)
